changelog: - **The Timeline no longer squeezes the canvas when the window gets shorter.** When run notices or strips raised the Timeline area's least height, making the window shorter in height alone could leave the canvas under its own least height of 160 px, until the splitter was moved. The area now comes down to its most at once. The splitter also says its most correctly after such a change; before, it kept the most from before the window changed.
